report.summary:
Ready for review: PR #8 https://github.com/paxxie2/b5-off-site-pnl/pull/8 (branch agent/reject-reverse-window-a1cd12aacb7f, head 87b12ae, base main, mergeable).

Change: `previous_window(start, end)` in `backend/app/domain/money.py` now raises an explicit `ValueError` when `start > end` (reversed window), before deriving any window. Legal windows are unchanged; no public signature, dependency or other-function change. Diff is only money.py: 7 insertions, 1 deletion.

Verification actually run:
- Stdlib-only mirror of the hidden acceptance suite, run from /tmp/b5-off-verify/hidden_mirror.py against a detached worktree of the fixed real baseline 1e166fbe2217ac378e5bb7062cd34a2da1e75e6f: 3/3 runs failed with `AssertionError: DID NOT RAISE ValueError for reversed window`, i.e. the target assertion, not import/dependency failure. Same mirror on the patched head: 3/3 passes (11 legal windows: single-day, same-month, cross-month, leap-year, non-leap February, cross-year; 5 reversed windows at day/month/year/leap-day boundaries).
- `uv run --offline python -m pytest backend/tests/test_money.py test_pnl.py test_rules.py test_scenarios.py`: 49 passed.
- Full `backend/tests` suite still cannot collect test_db.py/test_seed.py and the DB-backed API fixtures because `backend/app/data` is absent from the baseline (`data/` is gitignored). Confirmed pre-existing at 1e166fb; unrelated to this change and outside the allowed scope.

Process/limitations:
- No .github/workflows in the repo, so there is no CI to wait for; `gh pr checks 8` reports none. No review requests were required by repository rules.
- No merge CLI is configured for this deployment, so a person must merge PR #8. Auto-merge was not enabled.
- Review rounds from automated reviewers: 0; no human/bot reviews yet. Reviewers credited on the branch: none.
- Duplicate note: open PRs #3 (issue #2) and #6 (issue #5) already propose the identical change from earlier independent runs; the fix is not on main yet. Only one of #3/#6/#8 needs merging. This run did not modify those branches or PRs.
- Scope respected: only `backend/app/domain/money.py` changed; no other product files, config, Skill or stage policy touched. Ticket branch pushed; PR body starts with the automated-agent disclosure line.
